comment: Event -> possible narrator lines. Lines are picked at random per event. Audio files (assets/voice/) will map by line id later; V1 scaffold shows captions only.

game.start: Welcome to Jamaica, brethren! Touch di road!
community.enter: Dis is {community} — big up di area!
Yuh deh inna {community} now, drive good!
community.enter.Half Way Tree: Half Way Tree! Everybody pass through ya so!
HWT massive! Di clock tower still a stand!
community.enter.Linstead: Linstead! Carry mi ackee go a Linstead market!
Linstead Market — di song never lie!
community.enter.Moneague: Moneague! Di air fresh up here, nuh true?
community.enter.Faith's Pen: Faith's Pen! Pull over and nyam some jerk, nuh!
Bwoy, di smell a dat jerk chicken! Stop di car!
community.enter.Fern Gully: Fern Gully! Bamboo and fern all about — mind yuh speed!
Di gully dark and cool — watch di bend dem!
community.enter.Ocho Rios: Ochi Rios! Yuh reach, brethren — Dunn's River deh wait!
Welcome to Ocho Rios! Di north coast sweet, nuh true?
community.enter.Spanish Town: Spanish Town! Di old capital — history all round yuh!
St. Catherine capital! Big up di square!
